term: capacity for conscious relationship at a time
definition: Cognitive and affective capacity at the indicated world, person and time for reciprocal conscious interaction recognizing the other party. This is a capacity, not possession of belief or actual relationship. Not all humans at all times are assumed capable; the existential premise supplies its own witness.
